name: incident-stage-1
description: FORMAL EVIDENCE. Stage 1 - bus breakdown affecting 5 bus stops. The one-second, 50-analysis-jobs-per-incident intensity was selected from completed AWS fixed and extended-autoscale calibration evidence, not guessed from local throughput.

evidenceClassification.selectionBasis: AWS calibration established that 50 jobs/s creates genuine pressure and that 630 scheduled seconds gives target tracking time to become operational before arrivals finish.
